about: The local runs as `local list` shows them, or (with --lanes) the lanes of the sign-ins that member runs share. `mode` says which: `runs` (the key `runs` holds one row for each run, in the order the text lists them: the runs that exist, then the runs whose directory is gone) or `lanes` (the key `lanes` holds one row for each lock file). `state` of a run is display only, derived from the run's dispatch.json and a check of its runner process (the pid and its start token; nothing is signalled): prepared (no dispatch.json: an in-session run, or one `local run` has not started), waiting (the runner is alive and waits for a lock), running (the runner is alive), ended (the run finished, or its runner is gone) or unknown (the record cannot be read, the runner cannot be compared with a process, or the run directory is gone); it decides nothing that verify, clean or apply do. `lock_wait_s` is the whole seconds the runner waited for a sign-in lock, rounded up (0 when it did not wait or no record says). `repo_path_lead_stated` is the repository path as the lead's registry recorded it when the run was prepared, never read from the run directory and not checked now; null for a run of a repository URL. The verb exits 0 with a document and prints nothing else on standard output; a document that fails the check of this registry file is exit 70 with one line on standard error and no document, and a wrong call is exit 2.
writes: Nothing: no state, no lock, no token, no network and no file; the registry, the run directories, the lane records and /proc are only read, and no process is signalled.

mode.description: What the document lists: the runs, or (list --lanes) the lanes.

runs.description: One row for each run, in the order of the text list.

lanes.description: One row for each lock file the runtimes of the stored projects declare; empty when no runtime shares one.

role.description: The ability the run was prepared for (build, review ...), as the text list shows it; ? when it cannot be read.

slug.description: The slug of the run; - when the registry names none.

age_seconds.description: Seconds since the run was prepared; null when the start time is not a number.

applied.description: yes when `review apply` recorded the work, closed when `local close` took it as applied by hand.

merged.description: Whether the applied tip is on a branch other than agent/*: unknown for a run of a repository URL or a record that names no tip, none for a run that was closed by hand.

runtime.description: The runtime the registry names for the run; null for a run prepared before the project had extra runtimes.

lock_wait_s.description: Whole seconds the runner waited for a sign-in lock, rounded up; 0 when none.

repo_path_lead_stated.description: The repository path the lead's registry recorded for the run: lead-stated, never read from the run directory; null for a repository URL.

directory_gone.description: The run directory no longer exists (a reboot, or removed by hand); `state` is unknown.

saved_copy.description: The lead's saved copy of a run whose directory is gone, when there is one.

lock.description: The lock file as the runtime's definition declares it (~/DIR/.qargi-run.lock).

state.description: The word the text list starts the state with.

detail.description: The state as the text list prints it, for example `held, member alive, runner gone`.

holder.description: The holder as the text list names it (lead, run, kind and age); null for none.

waiting.description: The runs waiting for the lane, in the order they began to wait.

run.description: The slug of the waiting run, as the lane record gives it.

waiting_seconds.description: Whole seconds since it began to wait.
